items.term: inclusion cutoff year
items.value: Only include papers published in 2019 or later.

items.term: ablation condition
items.value: The specific set of components removed from the base model to isolate one factor's contribution.

items.term: primary metric
items.value: Accuracy, not F1, for classification papers, unless accuracy isn't reported at all.

items.term: edge deployment
items.value: Models under 500MB intended to run without a network connection.

items.term: review focus
items.value: Agent memory and continual learning this round, not general model compression.

items.term: flat policy
items.value: A control policy trained without any hierarchical or skill-based decomposition.

items.term: exclusion rule
items.value: Exclude any paper that only reports results on synthetic/simulated data with no real-world validation.

items.term: contradiction rate
items.value: The fraction of dialogue turns where the agent states something inconsistent with an earlier turn.

items.term: citation style
items.value: Short author-year citations, not numbered citations, in all saved notes.

items.term: confidence threshold
items.value: Only tag a finding as strong evidence if the reported improvement is 5 points or more; below that, tag it modest.
